scope: Terminal evaluation of frozen v2 runs; source laws are reconstructed exactly from their archived parameters.

marker.local_refinement_trigger: previous representative remains the best evaluated start
marker.last_preconditioner: full Fisher-like modal sensitivity preconditioner; full-J finite-difference gradient

frame_consistency_evidence.model_source: saved per-case robot.urdf, simulator equilibrium trajectory, exact archived inference source laws

marker.interpretation: The terminal marker-only estimate is still approaching: its estimated relative residual is comparable to physical distance. Absolute link poses and marker placement nevertheless have large errors outside their narrow proxy ellipsoids.

imu_marker.local_refinement_trigger: previous representative remains the best evaluated start
imu_marker.last_preconditioner: full Fisher-like modal sensitivity preconditioner; full-J finite-difference gradient

frame_consistency_evidence.model_source: saved per-case robot.urdf, simulator equilibrium trajectory, exact archived inference source laws

imu_marker.interpretation: The terminal fused relative mean is close to its desired value, while actual reaching and actual relative truth remain millimetres away. Large absolute biases cancel, and the fused relative covariance also understates its error. Additional elapsed time alone is not established as a remedy.

purpose: Evaluate estimated gravity-flexed link poses and goal candidates against simulator truth; distribution identity is assessed separately from physical accuracy.

truth_inputs: archived simulator equilibrium joint angles and tip trajectory
scene marker placement, base placement, and known URDF geometry

method.propagation: existing first-order core point_query and pose_query on exact archived joint source laws
method.position_and_orientation_dependence: full archived covariance retained; position and rotation proxy subblocks and joint six-coordinate errors are reported
method.state_error_metric: truth-versus-estimate Mahalanobis squared is NEES-style and is not a sensor innovation NIS
method.innovation_metric: per-native-camera-component NIS uses the actual frozen local target prior plus image likelihood covariance in the same chart; IMU NIS uses the frozen tangent target and configured variance
method.ellipsoids: 95 percent chi-square proxy ellipsoids on actual covariance supports; not a formal frequentist calibration study
method.rotation_error: right-chart truth displacement relative to the queried modal rotation, with first-order orientation mean correction
method.alignments: post hoc least-squares rigid/yaw fits for diagnosis only; never applied to candidates, visualization or control

limitations: This is an offline terminal audit of two fixed trajectories, not a statistical coverage experiment over repeated trials.
Core proxies and covariance ellipsoids are the implemented first-order approximations.
The test documents substantial estimation errors; it does not correct or certify the estimator.
A large common body/goal bias can cancel in relative reaching, without making either absolute estimate accurate.
The camera-to-hand attachment permits T_MH = inverse(T_CM) T_CH independently of absolute body localization; the current fused relative proxy can still be biased.
